drums.tags: Lo-fi hip hop. A Rhodes electric piano plays a jazz-influenced progression with a heavy tremolo effect and high-frequency roll-off. The drum kit features a muffled, low-pass filtered kick drum and a crisp, dry snare with a slight swing. A sub-bass synth follows the root notes of the piano chords with a soft attack. A recurring vinyl crackle and hiss layer persists throughout the arrangement. The tempo is 85 BPM in the key of C minor. A melodic lead is provided by a muted trumpet with a significant hall reverb, playing short, syncopated phrases. Occasional foley sounds of rain and distant city traffic are mixed into the background.
drums.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[vinyl crackle and hiss, rain foley]
[tremolo Rhodes electric piano enters]

[Main Loop]
[muffled kick drum, dry snare with swing]
[sub-bass synth enters]
[muted trumpet with hall reverb plays syncopated melody]

[Outro]
[drums and bass drop out]
[Rhodes piano fades with vinyl crackle and rain foley]

bass.tags: Industrial metal with cinematic orchestral elements. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted chugging riffs in drop tuning. A heavy drum kit features a gated snare and double-kick patterns. Orchestral strings and brass stabs provide rhythmic accents. Synthesizers contribute distorted bass pulses and high-frequency glitch textures. The arrangement uses sudden dynamic shifts and mechanical sound effects. 120 BPM, 4/4 time signature, D minor.
bass.prompt:
[Instrumental]

[Intro]
[distorted synth bass pulse]
[mechanical sound effects]
[orchestral brass stabs]

[Section A]
[palm-muted distorted guitar chugging]
[heavy kick drum and gated snare]
[staccato string section accents]

[Section B]
[double-kick drum patterns]
[sustained distorted guitar power chords]
[high-pitched synth glitch textures]

[Outro]
[sudden silence]
[reverb tail of final brass hit]
